name: pi-xt-context
description: Pi extension. Auto-loads nested context files (default: AGENTS.md) when the model works in a directory — via bash cd or any file tool. Injected once, durably; configured from settings.json.

scripts.bench: node bench/make-tree.mjs /tmp/pxt-bench 300 && PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=/tmp/pxt-bench mkdir -p /tmp/pxt-bench-agent && PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=/tmp/pxt-bench-agent strace -f -qq -o /tmp/pxt-bench.trace node --experimental-transform-types --import ./bench/alias.mjs bench/dedup.mjs /tmp/pxt-bench

author: furbyhaxx (https://github.com/furbyhaxx)
